The launch factory sends 90% to the IMD pool and 10% through the swarm’s separate distributor. The token mints the entire supply to its deployer and handles no allocation itself.

The 2% tax applies to transfers out of Uniswap v4’s PoolManager, including buys and liquidity withdrawals. Transfers into it are untaxed. The pool’s 1.25% swap fee is separate.

Fixed addresses & contract rules +

No owner, admin, upgrades or later minting. The tax rate and addresses cannot change.
